backend.integrator: IAS15 initial_dt=1e-6 d min_dt=1e-9 d epsilon=1e-6 adaptive=Global
backend.name: ASSIST (thor-rs-assist; built as thor run --backend assist builds it)

inputs.override_reason: DP2-only campaign (Joachim, 2026-09-18): the July tiling's footprint and seed pixels were built from DP2 alone, but its contracts record no dataset selection, so the run selects lsst_dp2 / X05 explicitly

panel_a_exposure.rule: the gathered exposure with the largest min(gathered detections, admitted detections within twice the aperture that were not gathered)

table.columns: gathered, ra, dec (deg, float32), time_utc (MJD UTC), night, state_id (exposure), seg_id (lowest segment whose guard admitted it; -1 not gathered), theta_x, theta_y (deg, float32, the transform's tangent-plane coordinates; null when not transformed), ss_object_id, designation
